messages.body:
**1. The page checks the cart first, then sends the order**

The Place order button (web/src/checkout/Checkout.vue:30) lands here; nothing is charged in the browser. Order matters: a **dry-run** create at web/src/checkout/placeOrder.ts:33 checks stock and prices before the customer is sent to their bank; only then the real create at :42. At the top of this range (:24-29) it first looks for an order already sent from this cart and just waits on that one.
